params.name: vpAreaName
params.description: 4D View Pro area form object name

overloads.semanticRole: The VP RESET SELECTION command deselects all cells, resulting in no current selection or visible active cell.

constraints: After deselecting all cells, a default active cell (A1) remains defined for 4D View Pro commands.
An error is returned if vpAreaName does not designate an existing 4D View Pro area.
